Main entry point.description: A main that returns an int exit code

Function.description: A typed function. Annotate bindings at string/int boundaries.

Immutable binding.description: An immutable binding. Top-level val needs an int/bool literal; var at file scope is E1007.

ORM Model.description: A model. Its table is created at startup; field types are string, int, float or bool.

Model read.description: Read all rows: Note.all(), Note.where("author_id = ?", who)

HTTP Route.description: A route handler. Return ok/err, a string, or an object literal.

Route with path param.description: A route capturing :id (or {id}); static routes win, * matches without capture

Route error.description: Route-only error reply. In a -> result fn use err("msg", code) instead.

Route success with status.description: Route success response with explicit status. Use err for 4xx/5xx (ok rejects them at check time).

Rate-limited route.description: Route with limit rate/unit (min/sec/s/ms) plus optional burst. At most 32 annotated routes.

Model CRUD.description: Model ORM: all, where (2-arg form is parameterized), create, delete.

Request helper.description: Request builtin. Only these members lower to builtins; anything else is a generic member read.

System telemetry.description: Live runtime counter, always () -> int. Percentiles are bucket edges.

Enum.description: Closed alternatives. union for tagged variants, type X = Y for an alias.

While loop.description: Loop form. There is no loop {} body (parse error); use while true.

For loop.description: Iterate a list; the loop variable takes the element type.

Result value.description: Construct a result value. In a -> result fn, bind first: return ok(expr) parses as a route response.

Try catch.description: Unwrap a result. catch runs on the failed branch; naming it binds the error string.

Match.description: Exhaustive match on a union variant. Expression arms use _ for the default.

Typed list.description: A list with a declared element type. Bare list takes it from the first push.

Object literal.description: A value, not text. Fields may be string, int, float, bool, a list of those, or another object.

Raw string.description: A triple-quoted string with no escape processing; ${holes} still interpolate

Standard library import.description: A std import (all lowercase). Resolves against the binary dir, its parent, then cwd; build from the repo root.

Relative import.description: A relative import. Flat global namespace; duplicate symbols are an error.
